notes.heading: Book Introduction - Philemon
notes.body: SCOFIELD REFERENCE NOTES (Old Scofield 1917 Edition) Read first chapter of Philemon The Epistle of Paul the Apostle to Philemon

notes.heading: DATE
notes.body: : Probably A.D. 64. It is one of the Prison Epistles. See Introductions to Ephesians and Colossians.

notes.heading: THEME
account
notes.body: Philemon 1:17,18 perfectly illustrate imputation: "Receive him as myself"--reckon to him my merit; "If he hath wronged thee or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account"-- reckon to me his demerit. See "Imputation," Leviticus 25:50. (See Scofield "James 2:23").
